name: ai-dev-team
description: Small standalone Claude Code plugins: guardrails, review, spec-upkeep, test-quality, metrics, browser, e2e, ui-review, architect and release.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Git pre-commit secret and comment checks, Claude Code hooks that apply them while Claude edits, a hook that blocks unscoped test commands, and a scoped test runner that prints only totals and failures.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Proven code review: review-bolt and sweep-area run the review, prove-findings keeps only findings a failing test proves, fix-findings fixes proven bugs one at a time with the owner, mutate-check shows a regression test guards its line, and design-critic attacks risky designs before coding.

plugins.name: spec-upkeep
plugins.description: Reports stale file paths, symbols, commands and links cited in project docs, and the check-docs skill fixes them to match the code.

plugins.name: test-quality
plugins.description: Flags decorative new tests with the test-critic agent, maps acceptance criteria to tests, and lists a branch's new tests and criteria with scripts.

plugins.name: metrics
plugins.description: Records one CSV row per merged PR with time to merge, review counts and token use from Claude Code session logs.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Starts and stops the app, takes screenshots of its pages and drives it step by step (clicks, typing, uploads, faked replies, console and network log) with a headless Chromium browser; other plugins use its app, capture and drive skills.

plugins.name: e2e
plugins.description: Writes Playwright tests from story acceptance criteria; the browser plugin starts the app.

plugins.name: ui-review
plugins.description: Reviews UI screenshots against a project's design tokens and UI rules: the ui-critic agent flags visible defects, a script checks every contrast claim, and findings go to a report and, if you choose, to issues.

plugins.name: architect
plugins.description: Proposes features, improvements and gaps from a project's code, specs and open issues. Every proposal's cites are checked by script, and the kept ones are filed as issues for specsmd inception. Never edits specs.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Works out each package's next version from conventional commits, writes its version file, changelog and tag, and ships a GitHub action that pushes the release and creates the GitHub release.
